depends_on: broad QR transfer admitted; generic cache wall transfer failed
layouts: exact same six layouts from V25_REDUCED_KEY_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_PLAN.json; no additions/removals
generator_rule: Generate layout-specific straight-line Python screen and direct functions from the frozen QR op classification. No runtime Op loop, candidate-flag branch, zip over operations, or dynamic group lookup in the candidate hot path. Fixed target-dependent QR outputs are stored in a compact cache; candidate-dependent QRs are emitted as explicit quarter_round/inverse_quarter_round calls. Logical-key word patch expressions are emitted per frozen layout.
baseline: Generate an equally specialized straight-line direct-word0 verifier for the same layout; do not compare specialized screen against generic baseline.

exactness_gate.required: generated screen full syndrome and generated direct predicate exactly match generic reference for every candidate

wall_benchmark.order: alternate screen algorithm and specialized direct baseline by repeat parity
wall_benchmark.timed_scope: target output + target fixed-cache setup + all 1024 candidates + survivor direct verification; layout-static source generation/compile is measured separately but not repeated per target

family_interpretation.broad_wall_realization: at least 4 of 5 non-control layouts pass all gates

claim_limit: Only constant-factor reduced-model engineering may be admitted. Leading candidate enumeration remains 2^b; alpha=1. No full-round claim.
forbidden: No target/layout/split/word/width/repeat/gate retuning after generated fresh-target results.
